column1: # Phase 41 -- token-level RTL isolation (RtlSafe) rule cases.
# Format:  logical-line
# The expected column is derived by hand from the rule text, not from the code:
#   * a token = a space-separated word
#   * "Latin token" = the token contains at least one letter A-Z/a-z
#   * digits and punctuation are NOT Latin: an EN number inside an RTL run is
#     resolved by UBA rule W and stays inside that run, so it never splits the
#     Persian sentence and must not move
#   * every Latin token that appears AFTER a Persian token moves to the head of
#     the line (relative order among moved tokens preserved) and is separated
#     from the Persian remainder by " | "
#   * an all-Latin line, and a line whose Latin already comes first, are untouched
